_note: ADR 0010 (T1-04) — PRE-REGISTERED before any co-deployment measurement. The frozen_transfers and delta_rule are OPERATOR-FROZEN and are NOT authored or modified by the build. The node_pair_mapping is DERIVED by the build from each transfer's documented methods and FLAGGED for operator audit (grounded in citable method content, not co-deployment intuition); where a transfer is not cleanly expressible in the 10-node vocab it is flagged, not forced.

node_pair_mapping._status: DERIVED by build from documented methods; FLAGGED for operator audit; not authored to pass.

statmech ensemble / Monte-Carlo methods applied to market dynamics
predator-prey coupled ODEs redeployed as economic growth-cycle dynamics
epidemic compartments redeployed as marketing diffusion / contagion

flags: N=8 positives requested but only 7 are cleanly expressible in the 10-node vocab; NOT forcing an 8th (ratification: 'flag, do not force'). Proceeding with 7 positives.

separation_definition: AUC = P(dist(positive_pair) < dist(noise_pair)) over all positive x noise comparisons; in [0,1], 0.5=chance, higher = the metric ranks documented-bridgeable pairs as nearer (more co-deployed) than non-bridgeable noise pairs.
noise_pairs: auto: all C(10,2)=45 node-pairs not in positives (38 pairs) form the noise comparison set.

delta_rule._status: OPERATOR-FROZEN; not modified by the build.
delta_rule.rule: permutation-null: delta = 95th percentile of (separation(co_deployment) - separation(topical)) over label shuffles of which pairs are labelled 'positive' (same count as the real positives)
delta_rule.rejects: fixed-number delta such as 1/sqrt(N) is REJECTED; delta is computed from this rule on the frozen held-out at measurement time.
